import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] vals = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            vals[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int x : vals) {
            total += x;
        }
        System.out.println(total / n);
        sc.close();
    }
}
